title: Refactor Hook Architecture Inlet-Outlet Adapter
prompt: Refactor the hook architecture to use inlet adapter -> neutral implementation -> outlet adapter pattern. CLI should accept native client events (VSCode PreToolUse, Windsurf pre_read_code, etc.) and resolve them to neutral events based on client + stdin context. The native configs should fire native events, not neutral events.
